properties.title: U Abundance · LP GRS 2° (Prettyman et al. 2006)
properties.lri:data_use_note: U tracks Th at a fixed ratio (U = 0.27 x Th) in this product; use the Thorium layer as the primary radiogenic-element measurement.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Column 15 (W_U, ppm) of the 2° quasi-equal-area table lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_2deg.tab (Prettyman et al. 2006) is used as ppm directly (no scaling), then the table rows are written as WKT polygons (longitude bin width varies by latitude to preserve equal area; the two polar caps are half the latitude height of the interior bands). The polygons are rasterized onto a fine 0.1°×0.1° grid, then downsampled with mode resampling to a 1°×1° output grid (half the 2° nominal band height, so the polar caps land exactly on an output pixel edge), then written as a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.
properties.lri:quality_note_short: Derived as U = 0.27 x Th, not an independent measurement. 2° grid (~60 km).
properties.lri:quality_note: Derived by linear spectral unmixing of Lunar Prospector gamma ray spectra (Prettyman et al. 2006), calibrated against the feldspathic lunar highlands meteorite composition. Validated against independent neutron-derived macroscopic absorption cross sections (Pearson r = 0.9885) and average atomic mass (Pearson r = 0.944). This dataset passed Planetary Data System peer review. Uranium is not an independent measurement here: the unmixing model constrains w_U = 0.27 x w_Th, so this layer tracks the Thorium layer at a fixed ratio rather than an independent gamma-ray signal.
